apps.localizedDescription:
Star Fox Enhanced:

A native C++/SDL3 port of UltraStarFox, with Original Star Fox and Star Fox EX experiences, high-frame-rate presentation, widescreen support, and optional visual enhancements using Codex AI (5.6 Sol, 6 Astra, 6 Sol).

THIS PROJECT WAS PORTED AND CODED BY AI/CODEX:

AI disclosure: This project is made with AI assistance, including OpenAI Codex and AI tools used for programming, testing, documentation and some visual assets.

This is an alpha release, not a cycle-accurate SNES emulator. A supported, unmodified retail ROM supplied by you is required. No retail ROM is included.

Get started:

• Launch the game. On desktop, place your supported .sfc/.smc ROM beside the executable, or set STARFOX_RETAIL_ROM to its path. Mobile apps provide a first-launch file picker.

versions.localizedDescription:
Star Fox Enhanced 0.0.8.8.3:

Changes since 0.0.8.8.2. Supply your own supported retail ROM; no ROM or private game data is included. Nintendo 3DS remains paused and is not packaged.

Smaller downloads and new icons:

• Converted enhanced backgrounds to lossless PNG: the embedded artwork drops from about 179 MB to 61 MB with the same decoded pixels and dimensions.

• Added the new Star Fox Enhanced application icon across desktop, mobile and supported console packages.

Includes the merged MODERN renderer update by CarltonCracker (PR #64):

• DYNAMIC LIGHTING adds coloured weapon/explosion/bomb lights and engine glow. Ray-traced sun shadows support the landscape, models, corridors and Space Armada boss room. Dynamic lighting is optional and off by default.
• Added optional HIGH POLY ARWINGS, including broken-wing variants, without changing simulation collision shapes or timing.
• Added MODERN output for SBS, over-under, interlaced, anaglyph and cross-view stereo. Leia SR continues to use its existing dedicated presentation path.
• Added MODERN build support for Android and PS5, plus a 3D Space Armada boss room, corridor/background accuracy fixes, 2D filters and level-select audio corrections. Android/PS5 device acceptance remains hardware-dependent.
• Renamed the renderer MODERN - VERY FAST and marked settings it does not implement as GPU ONLY, rather than suggesting those settings are active.

Compatibility fixes:

• #32: prevented retained exterior cruisers from drawing through Space Armada's final corridor/boss room across flat and shared stereo/VR paths. Kept the source object-removal correction and preserved outdoor ships.
• #49: added automatic host cartridge composition for Windows AMD/Radeon Vulkan while keeping GPU geometry/effects enabled. Live graphics-setting changes retire prior GPU work once before reconfiguration. This mitigates the reported driver-loss path; confirmation on the affected Radeon hardware is still needed, and this is not a claim that every AMD hang is resolved.
• Kept enhanced ground and enhanced sky/backgrounds independent of ray tracing. Reflections and ray-traced shadows retain their own requirements.

Updates and installation:

• Preserved the full 0.0.8.8.3 version in the in-game updater, including upgrades from 0.0.8.8.2. The updater selects the game package, never the optional DLSS add-on. Automatic installation remains for portable Windows x64/x86 and Linux x64; other platforms keep their existing update methods.

Platform packages are published only after the release build gates, Windows Defender package scans and checksum inventory pass. Build success is not a claim of hardware acceptance for every console, VR headset or graphics driver.
